images.title: Two ends of the scale: what explains the gap?
images.purpose: Shows Rajasthan at −93 and Manipur at +100 on the rice and wheat scale, 193 steps apart.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One long horizontal colour scale across the middle with two markers and a brace.
images.exact_structure: One long horizontal bar scale from −100 at the left end to +100 at the right end, coloured from amber ({second}) at the left through white at the centre to teal ({first}) at the right, with one unlabelled tick at the centre. Under the left end the label −100 wheat; under the right end +100 rice. Two dark pin markers above the bar: one at −93, labelled Rajasthan −93, and one at +100, labelled Manipur +100. A reddish purple (#CC79A7) brace above the pins joins them with the label 193 apart. A small question tag under the centre of the bar reads rainfall?
